mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_id AS scheduleId, m.item_name AS name, TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'HH24:MI') AS time, CASE WHEN s.cabinet_id IS NULL THEN 'prescription' WHEN c.category = 'supplement' THEN 'supplement' ELSE 'regular' END AS type, s.taken_at AS takenAt, 1 AS alarmEnabled FROM schedules s JOIN medications m ON s.medication_id = m.medication_id LEFT JOIN cabinets c ON s.cabinet_id = c.cabinet_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND TRUNC(s.scheduled_at) = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY s.scheduled_at ASC
SELECT medication_id AS "medicationId", item_name AS "itemName" FROM medications WHERE item_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND ROWNUM <= 15

SELECT TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "scheduleDate", MAX(CASE WHEN s.cabinet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hasPrescription", MAX(CASE WHEN s.cabinet_id IS NOT NULL AND (c.category = 'regular' OR c.category IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hasRegular", MAX(CASE WHEN s.cabinet_id IS NOT NULL AND c.category = 'supplement' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hasSupplement" FROM schedules s LEFT JOIN cabinets c ON s.cabinet_id = c.cabinet_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedules ( user_id, medication_id, scheduled_at, taken_at, cabinet_id ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{medicationId}, TO_DATE(#{scheduledDate} || ' ' || #{scheduledTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), NULL, ( SELECT MIN(cabinet_id) FROM cabinets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category = #{type} ) )
